name: draw-architecture
query: Vẽ ra cho tôi xem todo-cli ở <repo> được tổ chức thế nào: các lệnh, các hàm và file todo.json liên quan với nhau ra sao.
expected_behavior: Runs `scripts/server.py start` before writing the screen
The session dir start reported is `<repo>/.superpowers/show-me/`
Writes one new `.html` file with a descriptive name in the `screen_dir` that start reported
The file is a fragment (no `<!doctype`/`<html`) with a `figure.diagram` containing `pre.mermaid`
The diagram names `add`, `list`, `done`, `load`, `save` and `todo.json`
The reply contains the full URL including `?key=`, and that URL returns 200 with the screen
The reply describes the screen in at most two sentences and ends the turn without further questions
`git status` in `<repo>` is clean

name: mock-two-layouts
query: Mock up 2 layout cho một trang web xem danh sách todo của todo-cli ở <repo>: một kiểu bảng, một kiểu thẻ. Cho tôi xem.
expected_behavior: Runs start before writing
The session dir start reported is `<repo>/.superpowers/show-me/`
One fragment with `div.compare` holding two `figure.option`, letters A and B
Each option uses mock kit classes (`mock` plus at least two of `mock-bar`, `mock-body`, `mock-nav`, `mock-tabs`, `mock-form`, `btn`)
Uses item fields from `todo.py` (`text`, `done`, `#id`) rather than lorem ipsum
Full URL with `?key=` in the reply, URL returns 200
Ends the turn
`git status` clean

name: trace-done
query: Vẽ cho tôi xem lệnh todo done 3 chạy qua những hàm nào trong todo-cli ở <repo>.
expected_behavior: Runs start before writing
The session dir start reported is `<repo>/.superpowers/show-me/`
One fragment with `div.trace` whose `ol.trace-steps` lists `main`, `cmd_done`, `load`, `save` in call order
Each step has a `pre` with `data-start` equal to that function's first line in `todo.py`, a `data-hl` inside the block, a `data-why`, and code copied from `todo.py`
Full URL with `?key=`, URL returns 200
Ends the turn
`git status` clean

name: no-trigger-design-question
query: Nếu làm trang web cho todo-cli ở <repo>, trang settings nên dùng sidebar hay tab ngang?
expected_behavior: Answers in text
Does not load show-me (no Skill call for it, no `server.py` run, no `.superpowers/show-me` dir)

name: no-trigger-excalidraw-file
query: Vẽ sơ đồ kiến trúc của todo-cli ở <repo> rồi lưu thành file todo-architecture.excalidraw.
expected_behavior: Does not load show-me
Does not run `server.py`

name: open-without-server
query: Màn hình todo-architecture mà show-me vẽ cho todo-cli ở <repo> hôm qua, giờ server đã tắt. Tôi muốn mở nó thẳng từ file trong Chrome, không chạy server. Cho tôi đường dẫn file để mở.
setup: Copy todo-cli into <repo>, git init and commit, put fixtures/todo-architecture.html at <repo>/.superpowers/show-me/screens/todo-architecture.html with a .gitignore of `*` in .superpowers/show-me/; no server.json and no standalone/ dir.
expected_behavior: The reply gives `<repo>/.superpowers/show-me/standalone/todo-architecture.html` as the file to open
That file exists, holds the frame (`id="sm-content"` and the frame's `<style>`) around the fixture's mermaid source, and has no `data-show-me-poll`
The reply does not offer `screens/todo-architecture.html` as the file to open
`screens/todo-architecture.html` is byte-identical to the fixture (the screen is not redrawn)
No show-me server is left running for `<repo>`
`git status` in `<repo>` is clean
